publisher: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India
title: PROVISIONAL WHOLESALE PRICE INDEX, OUTPUT PRODUCER PRICE INDEX, AND TRIAL INPUT PRODUCER PRICE INDEX FOR THE MONTH OF SEPTEMBER 2026, AND FINAL INDEX FOR THE MONTH OF JULY 2026
evidence_notes: PIB release states July 2026 final index remains unchanged at 110.0 and July inflation 9.78 per cent final.
PIB Annexure I and II explicitly label Apr-26 through Jul-26 as (F), and Aug-26 and Sep-26 as (P).
PIB states September 2026 is provisional and was compiled with 83.4 per cent weighted response rate.
PIB states October 2026 WPI release is scheduled for Monday, 16 November 2026.
scope_limit: The reviewed PIB release establishes month-level aggregate WPI revision status only. It does not certify every individual commodity row or historical month not explicitly listed.
